reason: I've had a stuffy and runny nose for a week and want to rule out COVID.
diagnosis: Likely viral upper respiratory infection/common cold with mild congestion and clear rhinorrhea, given one week of nasal symptoms, no fever, cough, sore throat, dyspnea, or loss of taste/smell, and supportive care advice with COVID swab.
keyPoints: Characterize nasal symptoms: onset, duration, congestion vs rhinorrhea, discharge color
Screen for COVID/viral symptoms: fever, cough, sore throat, dyspnea, anosmia, fatigue
Ask about sick contacts, daycare exposure, and recent travel
Review OTC treatments tried and response
Check red flags/alternate causes: chest pain, severe headache, facial pain, sinus symptoms, GI symptoms
Assess relevant comorbidity and risk: type 1 diabetes, medication adherence, immunocompromise
Social history/exposures: smoking, drugs, work/school, dust/fumes/animals
manner: worrying about COVID, mildly bothered, cooperative
